### Adding an entry

<!-- Skip this checklist if you're fixing or removing an existing entry. -->

- [ ] The project is community-built, not an official Scouting America website, app, or publication.
- [ ] It's free to use, with no paywall or sign-up. Software has a public repository and an OSI-approved license.
- [ ] It's documented well enough for someone else to use it, and software is actively maintained.
- [ ] This pull request adds only one entry.
- [ ] The entry is at the bottom of the most relevant category.
- [ ] The entry uses the format `- [Project Name](https://link) - Short description.`
- [ ] The description is short and objective, starts with an uppercase character, and ends with a period.
- [ ] I searched existing issues and pull requests for duplicates.
